A conservationist uses three different methods to estimate the population of flamingos at the
lake.
method 1
• Take a photograph of the lake from the air.
• Divide the photograph into a grid of 100 squares.
• Count the number of flamingos in 10 squares.
method 2
• Count the number of flamingos seen flying in the sky above the lake on one day.
method 3
• Walk around the lake and count the number of flamingo nests.
